text_block_list.text:
The Swan Stakes, the race that will test Bamboo Memory's true caliber, has finally arrived!
As for Bamboo Memory herself—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yes, sir!
To be honest, I surprised even myself...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
My heart is burning so hot it feels ready to explode...!
My body is tingling with anticipation...!
And yet, my mind is completely calm...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Above all else!
I just can't wait to run!!
choice_data_list: Let's show them what your running is made of!
